title: Masterplan
plot_overview: A legendary thief recruits two young strangers to help steal a famous painting, then reveals an unexpected family connection. Thrust into a chaotic reunion, the new family must learn to work together—and tolerate one another—if they hope to pull off an ambitious heist.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you like heist stories mixed with messy family dynamics and comic tension; Not for you if you prefer grounded crime dramas or low-conflict reunions.
review_summary: Pros: chaotic family dynamic; heist premise; playful tension | Cons: prickly reunion; unlikely teamwork; familiar setup
